title: Spectral sparsity
statement: For $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, its spectral sparsity is the number of vectors $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ for which the vector Fourier coefficient $\widehat f(\gamma)$ is nonzero.
